name: Deadmanoz
cooked: Again not a paper, but I think it would be useful for a participant to survey and understand the various tools and approaches that are used to simulate the Bitcoin network, so there is a “go-to” resource for people wanting to simulate the network for whatever purpose? From the smaller size, something like warnet, up to simulating 10’s or 100’s of thousands of nodes.
